title: Quarterly Prioritization Grid and Experiment Budget for Hosted Model Catalog Runway
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a prioritized grid to allocate a fixed experiment budget across the hosted API model catalog for Q2. The grid should surface trade-offs between latency, unit cost, accuracy delta, and cohort impact so PM/Eng/Research can make trade-off decisions, plus a governance process for approving and measuring experiments.
background: We frequently get competing asks: add newer model variants, enable aggressive quantization, or promote cheaper model families. Without a consistent prioritization framework and explicit experiment budget, we over-index on feature requests and under-invest in reliability and capacity hedges. This ticket operationalizes a quarter-level prioritization mechanism tied to a bounded experiment budget and clear roll/rollback rules.
objectives: Deliver a prioritization grid that ranks 20 candidate model changes by cost delta, latency delta, predicted p95 impact, and customer cohort severity
Define an experiment budget (GPU-hours + request-volume % allocation) and a spend allocation playbook
Publish gating metrics and automated rollback triggers to the Console for each active experiment
Align Q2 OKRs with prioritized candidates and secure cross-functional signoff
milestones: M1: Inventory and scoring rubric published (2026-03-17)
M2: Simulation of capacity/cost impact and draft budget (2026-03-24)
M4: Experiment budget allocation + runbook published (2026-04-07)
M5: Pilot experiments scheduled and Console gating dashboards live (2026-04-21)
M6: Quarter kickoff signoff and runway freeze (2026-05-01)
acceptance_criteria: A1: A public spreadsheet (or internal DB view) exists with candidate rows, scoring columns, and final rank
A2: Experiment budget defined and translated into commitable capacity units (GPU-hours and percentage of hosted traffic)
A3: For each prioritized candidate, a short experiment charter exists with hypothesis, metrics, and rollback thresholds
A4: Console dashboards contain gating metrics and automated alerts for the active experiments
A5: Cross-functional signoff is recorded (PM, Eng, Research, Infra, CS)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overcommit of capacity leads to degraded latency for high-value customers -> Mitigation: reserve a 30% capacity hedge and tiered rollback
Risk: Scoring rubric misses a quality regression -> Mitigation: require small representative eval sets and immediate regression alarm
Risk: Lack of signoff slows rollout -> Mitigation: predefined decision SLA and mandatory signoff owners per candidate
decisions: Use a 40-point weighted rubric (accuracy:35, cost:25, latency:20, cohort-impact:20)
Experiment budget for Q2 set to 10k GPU-hours and up to 12% of non-enterprise hosted traffic
All experiments must include a canary window of minimum 2k requests and automated rollback thresholds
